audit.tool_note: T113's own audit_me_param_cards.py was not committed anywhere and no longer exists on disk, so this is a reconstruction to the same specification: for each MadSpin run directory it compares every numeric SLHA entry of the card each matrix-element directory is initialised from against the card the run itself carries. It was validated by pointing it at the ORIGINAL run directory, where it reproduces the reported defect exactly (MT 172.76 vs 173, WT 1.33 vs 1.4915, WZ 2.4952 vs 2.441404, WW 2.085 vs 2.0476).

regeneration.production_reuse_note: The defect is entirely inside MadSpin: the production run PROC_sm_nlo was always launched with the right numbers (its banner <slha> holds MT 172.76 / WT 1.33 / WW 2.085 / WZ 2.4952 / ymt 172.76, verified before reuse). So the 500k production LHE was carried over unchanged -- md5 9730e92f1433841f3dc2ebbfdb83e2e1, byte-identical to the original -- and only the MadSpin decay stage was rerun. That makes the old/new comparison exact: the production events, their weights and their cross-section are the same events, so every difference below is the fix and not Monte-Carlo noise.

what_changed.headline: The defect was real and is now gone, but it was immaterial. The cross-section did not move (-0.0001%, i.e. 1.3e-05 pb on 10.90 pb, against a 0.020 pb integration error) and the Delta phi shape did not move by any amount 500k events can resolve: the apparent shift is smaller than, and of the same character as, MadSpin's own decay-resampling noise, measured explicitly with a control run.

cards_archive.not_included: LHE files, matrix-element source and grids -- 19 GB, deliberately not mirrored.  The plotted content of those runs is data/histograms.npz.
cards_archive.why: The three non-sm_nlo samples sit in a 19 GB /tmp tree that may be reaped, and copying it is neither cheap nor useful.  What is cheap and does make the study repeatable is the steering: 124 kB of mg5_*.dat scripts, PROC_*/Cards/{run,param,proc}_card.dat and each MS_*/madspin_card.dat, copied verbatim out of setup.workdir.  With these plus run_smeft_fig5.py the samples can be remade from nothing; without them a reaped /tmp would take the exact run and param cards with it.

setup.cuts: none (fully inclusive leptons and b quarks; cut_decays False)
setup.decay_note: one decay line per t-like particle (multi-channel positional rule); both tops decay to electrons so every event holds exactly one e- and one e+
decays: decay t > w+ b, w+ > e+ ve
decay t~ > w- b~, w- > e- ve~
setup.fixed_order: off -- MC@NLO events are individual signed-weight events, not born/counter-event groups, so the option is not needed; it is in any case refused by MadSpin in the reshuffling spinmodes (PA, madspin)
setup.negative_weight_note: At ctGRe = -1 the O_tG interference is positive over the sampled phase space: MadSpin evaluates Tr(rho_prod) > 0 for every production event, including the ~0.02% whose MadEvent weight is negative -- those are unweighting residuals rather than negative-matrix-element points, and a MadSpin onshell run on the negative-weight events alone completes normally. At ctGRe = +1 every sign flips and spinmode=onshell aborts on the first event with MadSpinDegenerateWeight, because _check_production_density accepts only Tr(rho_prod) > 0. The negative-weight fraction is reported for the production sample and again after each decay; MadSpin preserves it exactly.
setup.observable: Delta phi(e-, e+), radians, folded onto [0, pi]
setup.pdf_note: the NLO sample deliberately uses the same LO set, so an LO/NLO comparison shows a change of order and not of PDF
setup.sign_convention: ctGRe = -1, so the eft_int sample is -2 Re(M_SM^* M_tG); the paper caption is written for ctGRe = +1

smeft_model.mass_note: the SMEFTsim v3.0.2 values are kept as they are; the restriction card fixes m_t = 172.76 GeV, Gamma_t = 1.33 GeV, and loop_sm is set to the same two numbers so the three samples describe one top quark
smeft_model.restriction_note: restrict_spyros.dat (all Wilson coefficients zero except ctGRe, LambdaSMEFT = 1000 GeV) with the ctGRe entry rewritten per sample. The coefficient is carried by the restriction card, not by a param_card override, because MadSpin initialises its density matrix-element library from <madspin_me>/Cards/param_card.dat -- the card output-standalone wrote from the model defaults -- and never from the run's own card. Model default and run value must therefore be the same number.

setup.workdir_note: DEPRECATED as a single pointer -- read setup.workdirs instead.  This key is what run_smeft_fig5.py writes for its own --workdir and it describes only the samples that driver made in that invocation (eft_int, eft_int_ctg_plus, sm_lo, and the SUPERSEDED sm_nlo).  The sm_nlo sample actually committed here lives elsewhere: see samples.sm_nlo.regeneration.workdir.  No plotting step reads any of these: data/histograms.npz and data/meta.json are the whole input, and every figure redraws with all four workdirs gone.
